title: On the Identification of Fair Auditors to Evaluate Recommender Systems based on a Novel Non-Comparative Fairness Notion
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on a novel non-comparative fairness notion for evaluating decision-support systems, with examples related to race, gender, and socio-economic status.

measurement_description: The paper does not benchmark or measure any aspect of faith or religion. It proposes a theoretical framework for evaluating fairness in decision-support systems using a novel non-comparative fairness notion.
